column5: The Rust leaf ports AppendFormatFloat, float precision selection, integer/year branches, dependency-closed decimal text, and already-encoded byte values; TiDB Datum temporal/JSON/enum/set conversion and charset encoding remain explicit owners outside this protocol crate.

The Rust leaf ports source result-charset precedence, column charset advertisement, registered binary/ASCII/Latin1/UTF-8/GBK paths, and explicit unsupported charset/collation state; the full session encoder buffer/lifecycle and broader charset registry remain open.
